title: Save Me a Seat: The Last Signal

shots.note: An unanswered message wakes inside a bronze mechanism.
Stars gather around an eclipse and the lights go out.
The old signal continues through a forgotten machine.
The little courier carries the message across an ending world.
The courier follows the bridge toward an impossible doorway.
An empty place waits at the edge of the universe.
The courier races through the stars.
Lights gather, each a life remembered.
A sea of lights rises above the water.
The signal approaches the place kept open.
The old message still reaches into the dark.
The courier runs onward beneath the stars.
A flower grows beside the fenced machinery of the past.
A pulse travels through the immense machine.
Copper filaments soften into roots and a living flower.
Entire ages pass beneath a sky of changing moons.
The courier keeps travelling.
A last burst of speed across the ridge.
An ocean of remembered lights gathers.
Countless lights fill a canyon beneath the eclipse.
The little signal returns to the empty place.
A living flower waits beside the machine.
The observatory and its stars turn toward the bridge.
A fragile signal hums within the machine.
Light becomes a root, and a flower opens.
The living cathedral reveals itself.
A river of lights rises toward the galaxy.
The courier crosses the doorway into the garden.
Remembered lights fill the dark.
Thousands of lights rise through the living tree.
A golden river carries the gathering toward the stars.
The lights spiral together above the garden.
The galaxy opens overhead.
The old signal reaches out one more time.
Two distant lights share a thread across the darkness.
